# FDG3073

> DO NOT use “Before” or “After” prefixes or postfixes to indicate pre- and post-events. Use present and past tenses as just described.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.6.3 Names of Events.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1713
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

CA1713 reports the Before and After prefixes, not postfixes. Renaming a public event changes the public API, so the fix is breaking; CA1713 has no code fix.
